LESSON: WRITING 12.4.1 GUIDED COMPOSITION: PERSONAL DIARY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.4: Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition: Personal Diary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition: Personal Diary, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why should we keep a record of what we do?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 12.4.1 Guided Composition: Personal Diary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: open mindedness and creativity as learners come up with their own diary entries.

113

● Digital literacy: interacting with digital technology as learners manipulate digital devices when searching for information on how to write

personal diaries from digital devices.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation as learners work together in groups to search for information on how to write personal diaries from digital devices.

Link to other subjects:

Learner is able to link the theme clean environment to their learning in Integrated Science, Science and Technology and Social Studies.
